cases.name: test-wait-process-normal-1
cases.description: Verifies that executing a short-lived external utility blocks the shell until completion.
cases.expected_behavior: The shell pauses execution until the external command exits successfully.

cases.name: test-wait-process-normal-2
cases.description: Verifies correct synchronization when running sequential commands.
cases.expected_behavior: Each command runs to completion before the shell proceeds.

cases.name: test-wait-process-edge-1
cases.description: Verifies synchronization behavior when handling empty or minimal output execution.
cases.expected_behavior: The shell waits for the process even when standard output is empty.

cases.name: test-wait-process-oracle-1
cases.description: Fuzzed verification of process completion waiting behavior.
cases.expected_behavior: Shell correctly blocks and captures termination status for variable workload utilities.
